chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: When you enter the toilet, say: 'In the Name of Allah, O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the wicked, the expeller of filth, the impure, the unclean, the Satan, the pelted one.'
So when you exit, say: 'In the Name of Allah, all praise is for Allah, Who saved me from the wicked, the expeller of filth, and removed the harm from me.'

And when you perform ablution, say: 'I testify that there is no god except Allah, O Allah, make me among the repentant and make me among the purified, and all praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended prayers to recite when entering and leaving the toilet in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the spiritual etiquette (adab) of the toilet, transforming a mundane act into an act of worship by invoking protection from the 'impure' (al-khabith) and Satan upon entry. The supplication upon exit highlights gratitude for physical relief, while the wudu du'a connects ritual purification with divine acceptance, reflecting the Shia emphasis on integrating spiritual consciousness into daily bodily functions. This practice underscores the holistic view of purity (taharah) in Shia jurisprudence, where physical cleanliness is inextricably linked to spiritual state.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muawiya Bin Ammar who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘When you enter the toilet, so say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I seek refuge with You<sup>azwj</sup> from the most wicked of the wicked ones, the unclean, the filthy Satan<sup>la</sup>, the pelted one.
So when you exit, so say, ‘In the Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Who Saved me from the most repugnant of the repugnant things, and Removed the harm from me’.

And when you perform Ablution (Wudhu), so say, ‘I testify that there is no god except for Allahazwj. O Allahazwj! Make me to be from the repentant, and Make me to be from the clean ones, and the Praise is for Allahazwj, Lordazwj of the worlds’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I heard abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘When going to a restroom say, “In the name of Allah, O Lord, I seek protection with You against filth and the filthy, unclean Satan, condemned to be stoned.”
When coming out of a restroom say, “In the name of Allah, all praise belongs to Allah who has saved me from filth and filthy materials and has removed from me hardship.”

When taking Wudu’ say, “I testify that no one, other than Allah, deserves to be worshipped. O Lord, make me of those who repent and of those who cleanse themselves. All praise belongs to Allah, the Cherisher of the worlds.’”
